summary.methods: 分析了超过 600 个嵌入-任务组合，评估预训练嵌入（包括但不限于生物学基础模型）用于扰动响应预测的效果，并提出多种嵌入的整合预测方法。
summary.relevance: 直接关联“预训练”主题，讨论预训练表征在扰动响应预测中的实际价值与整合策略。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值、整合方法细节及所评估模型与数据集的清单；结论限于所分析的嵌入-任务组合。

papers.title: Shared clones make random cell halves look reproducible in pooled screens
papers.abstract: Single-cell perturbation screens are used to train and evaluate models that predict perturbation effects, and model scores are judged against how reproducible the measured effects are. Reproducibility is usually judged by splitting each perturbation's cells into two random halves. This assumes that the halves are independent replicates. In pooled screens such as Perturb-seq, however, the cells carrying a guide RNA descend from a limited number of transduced cells, so two random halves contain the same clones: pseudoreplication whose unit is not marked in the data. Using perturbations that should have no effect as controls, we compared random halves with independent replicates from separate transductions, and tested directly with halves that differ only in their clones. In a genome-scale screen of primary T cells, null perturbations agreed between random halves almost always and between independent replicates only half the time, the rate expected from noise alone; measuring more cells did not remove this agreement. Splitting the cells into halves that share no clone, by the T-cell receptor constant region or by a clone barcode, largely removed the excess agreement. Its size equals the share of expression differences set by clones divided by the effective number of clones per perturbation; across 16 screens it was largest in T cells transferred into mice and in a genome-scale primary T-cell screen, one to two orders of magnitude smaller in cell lines, and smallest in non-dividing neurons. Shared clones inflate benchmark ceilings and reliability labels, and when a model's input and its scoring answer come from one transduction, published models that predict perturbation effects in a new cell state appear better than a baseline that ignores the perturbation; against cells from another transduction, most fall below it. Reproducibility should be judged across separate transductions.

summary.takeaway: Pooled 筛选（如 Perturb-seq）中随机对半划分的细胞常含相同克隆，造成伪重复，因而高估扰动的可重复性和基准上限；应按独立转导判断可重复性。
summary.methods: 以应无效应的扰动为对照，比较随机对半与独立转导复制；在原代 T 细胞全基因组筛选中检验，并用 TCR 恒定区或克隆条形码构造无共享克隆的划分；在 16 个屏幕中量化克隆共享导致的过度一致性。
summary.relevance: 直接涉及“单细胞扰动”的基准设计与模型评估可靠性，指出当前扰动效应预测模型评分可能被高估。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告 T 细胞等场景的定性及相对幅度结果，未给出全部数值；克隆效应对其他筛选体系的外推需进一步验证。

papers.title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
papers.abstract: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor's site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace's own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel's votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.

summary.takeaway: 提出以逐字引文支撑每条边的医疗软件采用知识图谱构建流水线，在 61 家厂商上达到 0.94 精确率和 0.71 召回率，并提供基于投票的置信度评分。
summary.methods: 确定性爬取厂商网站并配合预算受限的 ReAct 智能体检索开放网络；宽松抽取器提出带引文的关系，经全文指代读取、确定性检查和五模型九准则投票进行落地判定。
summary.relevance: 关联“知识图谱”主题，展示 LM 智能体抽取关系并用证据引文约束正确性的流程。
summary.caveat: 评估依赖由模型起草并二次核验的页面级键；与人工精选参考相比得分较低，89% 的额外保留关系虽可在页面找到，但未给出人工全面核验结果。

papers.title: Online Continual Learning in Edge-Cloud Applications
papers.abstract: Deployed machine learning models in real-world IoT and edge/cloud systems face a critical reliability bottleneck: the requirement for online adaptation to non-stationary data streams while operating without access to the full original training dataset. Performance is severely degraded when models encounter Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs or suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Addressing these challenges requires adaptation mechanisms capable of learning from evolving data streams while preserving previously acquired knowledge. This paper proposes an edge-cloud methodology for integrating Continual Learning (CL) with Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detection and Concept Drift Detection in IoT applications. The methodology incorporates ODIN and ECDD as alternative mechanisms for identifying informative samples for annotation and triggering rehearsal-based model updates. Experimental results across automotive, healthcare, and agricultural datasets demonstrate the applicability of the proposed methodology and its potential to support model adaptation while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向 IoT 边缘-云场景的持续学习方法，将持续学习与 OOD 检测和概念漂移检测结合，以选择信息量样本进行标注并触发基于回放的模型更新。
summary.methods: 以 ODIN 和 ECDD 作为信息样本识别与更新触发机制，在汽车、医疗和农业数据集上实验验证。
summary.relevance: 关联“持续学习”主题，关注非平稳数据流下的在线适应与灾难性遗忘缓解。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称结果展示适用性与潜力，未给出量化指标、基线对比及具体数据规模。

papers.title: Comparative Single-Cell Profiling of CRISPR Knockout and Interference Defines Modality-Specific Strengths in Functional Genomics
papers.abstract: Pooled CRISPR screens coupled with single-cell RNA sequencing enable high-throughput functional interrogation of gene regulatory networks, yet systematic comparisons of CRISPR knockout (CRISPRko) and CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) remain limited. We established a single-cell CRISPRko workflow and benchmarked it against CRISPRi using 87 sgRNAs targeting 29 unfolded protein response genes. CRISPRko generated transcriptional phenotypes highly concordant with CRISPRi, and induced comparable pathway-level responses albeit with distinct on-target and off-target effects between modalities. While CRISPRi allows direct assessment of target gene repression, CRISPRko provides an effective complementary approach for complete loss-of-function studies, expanding the toolkit for single-cell functional genomics.

summary.takeaway: 建立单细胞 CRISPRko 流程并与 CRISPRi 基准比较，发现两者转录表型高度一致、通路层面响应相当，但在靶向与脱靶效应上存在模态差异。
summary.methods: 构建单细胞 CRISPRko 工作流，用靶向 29 个未折叠蛋白反应基因的 87 条 sgRNA 与 CRISPRi 进行基准比较。
summary.relevance: 直接关联“单细胞扰动”与“GRN / Regulon”，为单细胞功能基因组学的扰动模态选择提供依据。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告效应量或统计数值；比较限于 29 个 UPR 基因和单一细胞体系，推广性需验证。

papers.title: Score-Preserving Continual Lasso under Task Shift
papers.abstract: Continual learning (CL) aims to learn from sequential tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting when historical data are no longer accessible. We study continual learning for high-dimensional sparse linear regression, where $\ell_1$ regularization creates a difficulty absent from continual ridge regression: that recursively reusing an $\ell_1$-penalized estimator can propagate earlier shrinkage and accumulate regularization bias across tasks. We propose score-preserving continual Lasso (SP-CL), which separates sparse estimation from state transmission by preserving the historical squared-loss score. Under squared loss, its cumulative estimator exactly recovers a full-history Lasso minimizer. When task coefficients coincide, it inherits the full-history sparse rate. For related task-specific coefficients, SP-CL uses a regularized current-task correction that leaves the transmitted state unchanged and attains the offline source-assisted rate under an oracle related-task condition. We also derive Overall/BWT/FWT decompositions that distinguish historical information loss, task conflict, and current-task specialization, and validate the resulting regimes in simulation.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SP-CL，将稀疏估计与状态传递分离并保留历史平方损失得分，使累积估计在平方损失下精确恢复全历史 Lasso 解，并给出任务系数一致或相关时的收敛率。
summary.methods: 针对高维稀疏线性回归的持续学习，保留历史得分并采用正则化当前任务校正；推导 Overall/BWT/FWT 分解，并通过模拟验证各区间。
summary.relevance: 关联“持续学习”主题，针对 ℓ1 正则化在持续学习中的收缩偏差累积问题提供方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要报告理论结果与模拟验证，未给出真实数据实验；相关任务速率依赖 oracle 相关任务条件。

papers.title: Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithms
papers.abstract: Adversarial sharpness penalty per iteration of a base optimizer, known as sharpness-aware minimization (SAM), is an accepted technique to improve generalization in deep learning. Recently, Muon has emerged as a dominant optimization algorithm for training large language models (LLMs). It achieves lower sample complexity for heavy-tailed gradient updates - a phenomenon common in LLM training. However, sharpness penalties with Muon updates are yet largely unexplored in the literature. Moreover, the behavior of SAM under heavy-tailed noise is unknown both theoretically and empirically. A potential reason for this gap is the additional cost of extra gradient computation per iteration for penalty perturbations in SAM, which becomes prohibitive for LLMs. This paper introduces Sharpness-aware Orthogonalized Momentum Algorithm (SOMA) to combine a computationally efficient and theoretically grounded perturbation scheme with the Muon algorithm. The key idea is to use stale (purely) stochastic gradient noise for adversarial perturbations. Theoretically, we show that SOMA's sample complexity is invariant to the perturbation direction. We provide explorations and insights into SOMA's robustness to heavy-tailed gradient noise. We extensively explore SOMA's efficacy in (a) mitigating quality degradation due to post-training quantization, and (b) catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning of LLMs.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SOMA，将计算高效的扰动方案与 Muon 结合，理论上证明样本复杂度与扰动方向无关，并考察其对重尾梯度噪声的鲁棒性及在量化后降质和微调遗忘中的效果。
summary.methods: 使用陈旧纯随机梯度噪声构造对抗扰动，与 Muon 优化器结合；进行理论样本复杂度分析和实验探索。
summary.relevance: 关联“大语言模型”与“持续学习”，面向 LLM 训练与微调中的泛化、量化和灾难性遗忘问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体实验指标和数据；对 SAM 在重尾噪声下的行为仅称提供探索与洞见，理论覆盖范围需查看全文。

papers.title: Can Test-Time Memory Evolution Outperform Test-Time Training for Scientific Discovery?
papers.abstract: Recent \emph{test-time training} (TTT) frameworks have enabled open-weight large language models (LLMs) to outperform inference-only frameworks powered by frontier models on scientific discovery tasks. However, TTT introduces additional computational cost for online weight updates during the discovery process, making computational efficiency an important consideration when scaling to larger models. This motivates us to explore an efficient \emph{test-time adaptation} method for scientific discovery. We introduce \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} (TTME), a plug-and-play test-time adaptation method, as an alternative to TTT. TTME continually updates the external memory by distilling the experience to guide subsequent discovery without updating model weights. To have a clean comparison, we evaluate TTME and TTT under the same discovery framework, replacing only the test-time adaptation method. Our evaluation shows that TTME outperforms TTT on all five mathematical tasks, while reducing computational cost by $82.8$-$84.6\%$ in FLOPs and $47.7$-$58.4\%$ in runtime. These results establish TTME as an effective and computationally efficient alternative to TTT in the evaluated discovery settings.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TTME，通过持续更新外部记忆而非更新模型权重实现测试时适应；在相同发现框架下，于五个数学任务上优于 TTT，并显著降低计算成本。
summary.methods: 在同一科学发现框架中仅替换测试时适应方式，对比 TTME 与 TTT；报告 FLOPs 降低 82.8%–84.6%、运行时间降低 47.7%–58.4%。
summary.relevance: 关联“大语言模型”与“持续适应与预训练”，探讨比测试时权重更新更高效的适应替代方案。
summary.caveat: 比较限于五个数学任务和同一发现框架；摘要未说明在更广泛科学发现任务上的表现。

papers.title: GeoSinkhorn Flow: Geometry-Aware Flow Matching for Perturbation-Conditioned Dynamics in Single cell Data Phenoscapes
papers.abstract: Single-cell technologies increasingly enable large-scale profiling of complex biological systems across many experimental perturbations, but understanding how a system reorganizes across an entire space of conditions is difficult to interpret from single-cell embeddings alone. Phenoscapes address this by embedding entire cell-state distributions, rather than individual cells, as points in a data-driven landscape. Thus, a single dot represents one experimental condition rather than one cell, yielding a map of the perturbation or patient landscape that reveals how phenotype varies continuously across conditions. Phenoscapes remain a comparatively new and underexplored representation and existing static phenoscapes position experimental conditions relative to one another without specifying trajectories that describe how a cellular population moves from one condition to another. Flow- and trajectory-based models for single-cell data are numerous, but existing approaches operate at the level of individual cells, are not built to respect the geometry of a phenoscape, and typically cannot generalize their predicted flows to conditions not seen during training. Here we introduce GeoSinkhorn Flow, a perturbation-conditioned, geometry-aware flow-matching framework specialized designed to convert a static phenoscape into a dynamic phenoscape, in which each condition-level point is additionally connected by geodesic, condition-aware transport trajectories that are consistent with the phenoscape's underlying geometry. GeoSinkhorn Flow can also model transitions directly between time points without constructing a phenoscape. GeoSinkhorn Flow uses heat-diffusion geometry to define manifold-aware transport costs and trains a geometric autoencoder whose latent Euclidean distances stay aligned with the static phenoscape geometry while extending it to unseen cells. By explicitly conditioning the learned transport dynamics on perturbation-specific gene or drug embeddings, GeoSinkhorn Flow generalizes its trajectories to new measurement conditions, produces intermediate progression states along a trajectory, and extends predictions to unseen cells and held-out perturbations. An unbalanced optimal transport variant further learns growth or transition weights, so that changes in relative cell-state abundance or transition propensity are modeled together with state movement. Across synthetic manifolds, patient-derived organoid drug responses, Perturb-seq knockdowns, and time-resolved CyTOF signaling, GeoSinkhorn Flow recovered intrinsic manifold geometry, inferred biologically coherent response trajectories, and generalized to held-out drug combinations, perturbation genes, and time points. Together, these results establish GeoSinkhorn Flow as a perturbation-conditioned, phenoscape-consistent dynamical framework, distinct from standard flow-matching approaches, for converting static phenoscapes into dynamic ones that generalize across experimental conditions.

summary.takeaway: 提出 GeoSinkhorn Flow，将静态 phenoscape（以条件级分布为点的表型景观）转化为动态 phenoscape：为每个条件点连接符合底层几何的、条件感知的测地传输轨迹，并能泛化到未见细胞与留出扰动条件。
summary.methods: 基于热扩散几何定义流形感知的传输代价，训练几何自编码器使隐空间欧氏距离与静态 phenoscape 几何对齐；以扰动特异的基因或药物嵌入为条件学习传输动力学；提供非平衡最优传输变体以同时学习生长/转换权重；在合成流形、患者来源类器官药物响应、Perturb-seq 敲低和时间分辨 CyTOF 信号数据上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作面向单细胞扰动数据，研究细胞群体在扰动条件空间中的状态迁移与响应轨迹，与单细胞扰动主题直接相关；其条件级建模思路补充了以单细胞为单位的流匹配方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出各数据集的定量指标、基线对比细节与计算成本；方法依赖热扩散几何与自编码器对齐质量，对稀疏或噪声较大数据的稳健性未在摘要中说明，泛化到留出扰动的适用边界也需实验数据进一步确认。
